semanticChecks: Morning attendance not all task checks; changed delivery/machines linked to own routes/procedures; hazard naming not concrete measures; old check sheet not current result.
Safety cycle includes changes during work; findings/instructions distinct from improvement; separate submitted plans not common agreement; work end not fire/public-risk management completion.

Hiring/task-change education not experience alone; safety versus health hazards, operation versus inspection/PPE and normal versus abnormal/evacuation content retained; duration not proof of understanding.
New-site education differs from hiring orientation; mixed crews need common coordination; supervisor name not contact readiness; distributing material not comprehension.
Helmet/shoes/full-body harness distinct functions; conformity marks not damage check; fall height not universal selection/education; transition dates distinct from use duties/current suitability.

Eyewear flying particles/heat/harmful light distinct; dust filtering not gas protection or oxygen supply; glove suitability includes rotating-machine entanglement; clear face shield not welding-shade performance.

Air temperature not site heat-stress assessment; humidity/radiant heat and actual place/time retained; cooling facility not full plan or all-person health check; suspected symptoms reported without relying on endurance; green cross not emergency instructions/contents/contacts.
limitations: AI translation and author self-review only. No independent native-speaker, technical, rights or release approval; authored Japanese translated without independently updating legal/safety guidance.
